checks: Conclusion and brief drafts restore their exact wording, original revision, expanded section and caret without autosaving; explicit Save clears recovery.
An unfinished selected investigation, including an invalid blank title, survives reload; explicit Discard restores saved work and prevents resurrection.
Input and formula modes retain both representations through repeated switching and reload, keep focus, and save only the active canonical representation.
Originally calculated variables retain authored formula and new inputs in a draft; renaming a dependency updates the hidden formula too.
Newer canonical revisions keep recovered drafts in conflict, preserve their original base in Keep draft, block stale export and permit deliberate Discard.
New and opener-created tabs never adopt another tab’s analysis draft; closing a clean observer cannot erase same-tab recovery.
A failed save keeps the calculation draft recoverable, while an untouched new calculation can be dismissed after reload without creating a record.
Standalone recovery is isolated by exported canvas identity, retains both modes, and explicit save produces portable canonical data without touching the live session.
Unavailable browser storage is visible in live mode and Keep draft preserves the complete pending conclusion without claiming durable recovery.
